See below a compact proposal with three candidate windows and local conversions; I included a small fallback policy in case of last-minute DST confusion. I also attached a timezone matrix PDF and a tentative ICS for each slot so you can forward to Samir/Priya.

Candidate slots (all 75 minutes with 15 minutes buffer after):
1) 08:00 UTC (16:00 PST / 09:00 CET / 13:30 IST) — early US afternoon, mid EU morning, early evening IST
2) 15:00 UTC (07:00 PST / 16:00 CET / 20:30 IST) — late US early morning, late EU afternoon, 20:30 IST (Priya-friendly)
3) 22:00 UTC (14:00 PST / 23:00 CET / 03:30+1 IST) — avoids US core hours but pushes EU late-night and APAC overnight (least preferred)

DST note: US fallback to standard time occurred earlier this month; EU stays on CEST until last Sunday of October, so the offset between PST and CET is currently 9 hours in this window. We'll reconfirm offsets 48 hours prior and include explicit local-time labels in the calendar invites.

If you can confirm which of the three works for Samir and Priya, we'll finalize and send invites. If none, propose 2–3 specific times and we'll try to accommodate.
